findings.evidenceJa: 街に出る
findings.governingReading: go out into town
findings.explanation: The patrol area is enlarged from the town to a city.

findings.highlight: Saber is the only one who can sense our enemies
findings.evidenceJa: 敵の気配を察知できるのはセイバーだけ
findings.governingReading: only Saber can detect the enemy’s presence
findings.explanation: A specific presence-sensing role becomes broad ability to sense enemies.

findings.highlight: use magic to set up traps
findings.evidenceJa: 魔術を用いて罠を張る
findings.governingReading: use Magecraft to lay traps
findings.explanation: The technical category Magecraft is generalized to magic.

findings.highlight: We can use that to our advantage
findings.evidenceJa: その行動そのものが付け入る隙だ
findings.governingReading: that activity itself creates the opening one can exploit
findings.explanation: The precise claim that acting exposes a vulnerability becomes a vague advantage.

findings.highlight: Lots of magical energy will be needed if either one does something
findings.evidenceJa: どちらかが動けば大きな魔力が働く
findings.governingReading: when either Servant or Master acts, great magical energy comes into operation
findings.explanation: Observable magical activation is changed into an energy requirement.

findings.highlight: I can detect the lingering traces of their power
findings.evidenceJa: 使われた魔力の残り香ぐらいは嗅ぎ取れる
findings.governingReading: I can at least smell the lingering scent of magical energy that has been used
findings.explanation: The tracking metaphor and identity of the residue are weakened.

findings.highlight: Saber told me to stay at the house
findings.evidenceJa: セイバーは一人で街に出る
findings.governingReading: Saber insisted she would patrol the town alone and I should remain home
findings.explanation: Saber’s proposal to go out alone is omitted.

findings.highlight: I refused, saying I would go with her
findings.evidenceJa: それはこっちも一緒に戦うと言い張った
findings.governingReading: I insisted in return that we would fight together
findings.explanation: Shirou’s matching assertion of joint combat becomes simple refusal.

findings.evidenceJa: 不毛だった意地の張り合い
findings.governingReading: a somewhat fruitless contest of wills
findings.explanation: The characters’ stubborn clash is reduced to conversation.

findings.evidenceJa: 今夜出陣を控えている
findings.governingReading: we are due to sortie tonight
findings.explanation: Saber’s combat-ready framing becomes a patrol plan.

findings.highlight: you need 6 units to sustain yourself. yourself daily
findings.evidenceJa: 肉体維持に必要な魔力は６
findings.governingReading: six units of magical energy are required to maintain your body
findings.explanation: The English duplicates “yourself” and breaks the sentence.

findings.highlight: you could use about 10 units during a battle
findings.evidenceJa: 通常の戦闘で消費する魔力
findings.governingReading: a normal battle consumes about ten units
findings.explanation: Expected consumption becomes optional possible use.

findings.evidenceJa: 同格の英霊相手
findings.governingReading: Heroic Spirits of equal rank
findings.explanation: Saber’s comparison to opponents on her own level becomes an unclear rank reference.

findings.evidenceJa: ランサーには胸を穿たれ
findings.governingReading: Lancer pierced her chest
findings.explanation: The location and boring force of Saber’s wound are omitted.

findings.highlight: Most of my magical energy is fixed on protecting me
findings.evidenceJa: 魔力は、その大半を守りに固定しています
findings.governingReading: most of my magical energy is fixed into defense
findings.explanation: A technical allocation to defense becomes personal protective action.

findings.highlight: maintaining your body and your armor is the same thing
findings.evidenceJa: 肉体の維持と鎧の維持は同位
findings.governingReading: maintaining the body and maintaining the armor stand on the same level
findings.explanation: Equivalent maintenance priority becomes literal identity.

findings.evidenceJa: 霊体になる
findings.governingReading: assume spiritual form
findings.explanation: A Servant’s reversible state change is rendered as becoming a spirit.

findings.highlight: I guess this is good enough
findings.evidenceJa: 下ごしらえはこんなんでいいかな
findings.governingReading: I suppose that is enough preliminary preparation
findings.explanation: Shirou’s cooking-language joke about tactical groundwork disappears.

findings.evidenceJa: 緊張感に欠ける
findings.governingReading: it lacks an appropriate sense of tension
findings.explanation: A deficiency in seriousness becomes an action that reduces tension.

findings.evidenceJa: 危機感というものが薄れた
findings.governingReading: my sense of danger had faded
findings.explanation: A reduced sense of danger becomes total disappearance.

findings.highlight: she has her hands full with maintaining her body
findings.evidenceJa: 日々『ここにいる』だけで精一杯
findings.governingReading: each day, merely “being here” takes all she has
findings.explanation: Saber’s precarious continued manifestation is reduced to bodily upkeep.

findings.highlight: how many times more of my magical energy it would take to fill her up
findings.evidenceJa: 俺の何倍あるかなんて比べる
findings.governingReading: compare how many times greater her capacity is than mine
findings.explanation: A comparison of innate capacity becomes a calculation of refilling Saber with Shirou’s energy.

findings.evidenceJa: 最も優れたサーヴァント
findings.governingReading: the most excellent Servant
findings.explanation: The English uses a malformed superlative and shifts evaluative nuance.

findings.evidenceJa: 莫大な魔力
findings.governingReading: an enormous quantity of magical energy
findings.explanation: The exceptional cost of a Noble Phantasm is weakened.

findings.highlight: she’s mad at me for being a burden
findings.evidenceJa: セイバーに負担をかけている
findings.governingReading: I am placing a burden on Saber
findings.explanation: Shirou burdening Saber is reversed into Shirou himself being the burden.

findings.highlight: when you have a better understanding of what Servants are
findings.evidenceJa: サーヴァントというものを実感してから
findings.governingReading: once you have more fully felt what it means for me to be a Servant
findings.explanation: Embodied realization of Servanthood becomes generic conceptual understanding.

findings.evidenceJa: 行儀よくテーブルの前に正座する
findings.governingReading: kneels properly in seiza before the table
findings.explanation: Saber’s formal seated posture is omitted.

findings.evidenceJa: こっちの言い分を聞いてくれる
findings.governingReading: she hears out my side of the argument
findings.explanation: Saber’s willingness to consider Shirou’s position becomes obedience.

findings.evidenceJa: 魔力維持の問題について
findings.governingReading: the problem of maintaining magical energy or magical existence
findings.explanation: The underlying maintenance problem is narrowed to conservation.

findings.evidenceJa: 口裏はさっき合わせた通りにやってくれ
findings.governingReading: stick to the cover story we agreed on earlier
findings.explanation: Mutually coordinated deception becomes a unilateral instruction from Shirou.

findings.highlight: I cut some white radishes and put them into the saucepan
findings.evidenceJa: 大根をドッカドカにぶった斬って、ドバーっと鍋に投入する
findings.governingReading: I hack the daikon into great chunks and dump them thunderously into the pot
findings.explanation: The exaggerated sounds and violent cooking manner are flattened.

findings.highlight: they’re looking at me for an explanation
findings.evidenceJa: じーーーーーっと見つめてくる
findings.governingReading: they stare fixedly at me for a very long moment
findings.explanation: The visual comic beat is converted into an inferred communicative purpose.

findings.highlight: the hot tea sits there untouched
findings.evidenceJa: 熱い緑茶はとっくに冷めきっていた
findings.governingReading: the once-hot green tea had long since gone completely cold
findings.explanation: The passage of time is omitted, leaving the tea paradoxically hot.

findings.highlight: if an acquaintance of yours stays here
findings.evidenceJa: お知り合いの方が住む
findings.governingReading: if an acquaintance is going to live here
findings.explanation: Sakura’s neutral reference is made an acquaintance specifically of Shirou, contradicting the cover story.

findings.evidenceJa: 名前通り無愛想
findings.governingReading: unsociable or curt, just as her name suggests
findings.explanation: Saber’s reserved manner is narrowed to blunt speech.

findings.highlight: She might sound strange since she’s not used to Japan
findings.evidenceJa: 日本になれてないんでおかしなところもある
findings.governingReading: because she is unused to Japan, some aspects of her behavior may seem odd
findings.explanation: Broad cultural unfamiliarity is narrowed to sounding strange.

findings.highlight: it’ll really help me out if you can help her out
findings.evidenceJa: 桜が教えてくれると助かる
findings.governingReading: it would help if Sakura taught her
findings.explanation: The proposed household and cultural teaching role becomes unspecified help.

findings.evidenceJa: 苦手意識を持ったのか
findings.governingReading: has she developed discomfort or an aversion
findings.explanation: Shirou’s tentative reading of Sakura’s avoidance is softened to nervousness.

findings.evidenceJa: かつおのたたきサラダ風
findings.governingReading: seared bonito prepared salad-style
findings.explanation: A specific seared bonito dish is mistranslated as minced fish.

findings.evidenceJa: ピリリと辛いねぎソース
findings.governingReading: a sharply spicy green-onion sauce
findings.explanation: The sauce’s heat is changed to vague zest.

findings.evidenceJa: 中がほくほくで美味しい
findings.governingReading: deliciously fluffy and steaming inside
findings.explanation: Taiga’s praise of the tempura’s interior texture becomes juiciness.

findings.highlight: She picks up the pot of oil
findings.evidenceJa: よいしょ、と油の張った鍋を持ち上げる
findings.governingReading: with a small heave, she lifts the oil-filled pot
findings.explanation: Sakura’s audible exertion and the pot’s fullness are omitted.

findings.evidenceJa: ざぶざぶ、と音をたてて食器を洗う
findings.governingReading: I wash the dishes with a loud sloshing sound
findings.explanation: The audible domestic staging is omitted.

findings.evidenceJa: タオルが減ってますよ
findings.governingReading: there are fewer towels here
findings.explanation: Countable towels are paired with the ungrammatical “less.”

findings.evidenceJa: 食器の置き場所も違ってます
findings.governingReading: the dishes are stored in different places than usual
findings.explanation: A systematic change in storage locations becomes vague movement of plates.

findings.highlight: The plates have been moved around
findings.evidenceJa: 普段とは違う食器の位置
findings.governingReading: the dishes are in locations different from usual
findings.explanation: The systematic disturbance of household storage is again generalized to plates being moved around.

findings.evidenceJa: 空っぽになったペーパータオル
findings.governingReading: the paper towels have been emptied
findings.explanation: An emptied supply becomes total absence.

findings.evidenceJa: 何枚か持ち出されているタオル
findings.governingReading: several towels have been taken out
findings.explanation: Evidence that towels were removed becomes unexplained absence.

findings.evidenceJa: ぽん、と手を叩く
findings.governingReading: I clap my hands in realization
findings.explanation: A comic physical beat is replaced by an internal statement.

findings.highlight: Tohsaka was the one who treated me
findings.evidenceJa: 倒れた俺を看病してくれたのは遠坂
findings.governingReading: Tohsaka was the one who nursed me after I collapsed
findings.explanation: Shirou’s collapse and Rin’s sustained care are reduced to treatment.

findings.evidenceJa: ペーパータオルやら何やら
findings.governingReading: the paper towels and other such supplies
findings.explanation: Other displaced household supplies are omitted from Shirou’s inference.

findings.evidenceJa: ちょっとした縁で家にあがってもらった
findings.governingReading: a small connection led me to invite her into the house
findings.explanation: The circumstantial connection and hospitable invitation become a unilateral summons.

findings.evidenceJa: 慈愛に満ちてる
findings.governingReading: brimming with benevolent compassion
findings.explanation: Shirou’s exaggerated mock praise becomes personal affection.

findings.highlight: I don’t mean the last half
findings.evidenceJa: 後半は断じて本気ではない
findings.governingReading: I absolutely do not mean the latter half seriously
findings.explanation: The emphatic disclaimer marking Shirou’s sarcasm is weakened.

findings.evidenceJa: 消え去ってしまったのだこんちくしょう
findings.governingReading: has vanished from within me, damn it
findings.explanation: Shirou’s comic frustration at Rin’s destroyed honor-student image disappears.

findings.highlight: She has nothing to do with this place
findings.evidenceJa: ぜんぜん関係ない
findings.governingReading: she has no relation to us at all
findings.explanation: Sakura’s possessive insistence about interpersonal connection is redirected toward the house.

findings.highlight: Sakura hangs her head and tries to control herself
findings.evidenceJa: 桜はじっと体を押さえる
findings.governingReading: Sakura remains bowed and presses or holds her body still
findings.explanation: A visible bodily action becomes an inferred attempt at emotional self-control.
